title: pp.fft-split-st~
description: `pp.fft-split-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.fft-split~`, splitting left and right input signals at a specified frequency into separate low-pass and high-pass stereo outputs. Its FFT block size and overlap can be set by creation arguments (defaults: 1024 and 4) or control messages, and it supports saving and recalling up to 20 presets.
